_about: Pre-registered mapping from B. V. Raman's strength-verdict phrases (HTJAH) onto the engine's 9-grade VERDICT_SCALE. COMMITTED BEFORE ANY SCORING so it cannot be tuned to flatter the engine. Patterns are matched WORD-BOUNDED against the lowercased verdict phrase, MOST-SPECIFIC FIRST (first hit wins). A phrase matching no pattern is 'unmappable' -> excluded from scoring and logged, never guessed.
_bugfix_2026_07_08: Two matcher/vocabulary defects fixed after a forensic pass (see notes): (B1) matching is now WORD-BOUNDED so 'afflicted' no longer matches inside 'unafflicted', and 'unafflicted'/'unsullied'/'well disposed' get their own faithful patterns; (B2) bare 'afflicted' (a subject's verdict) now ranks ABOVE bare 'blemished' (usually another planet's), so 'Venus is afflicted by a blemished Mercury' maps to afflicted, not moderate. Specific '<x> blemished' subject verdicts (feebly/moderately/considerably) are unchanged and still rank first.

notes.feebly: 'feebly weak' / 'feebly strong' both denote a barely-present strength -> weak (1).
notes.quite strong: Raman's 'quite strong[ly]' sits just under 'fairly powerful' -> fairly strong (5).
notes.inclining towards good: a tentative positive, below a settled 'good' -> moderate (2).
notes.unafflicted: mere absence of affliction (often qualified, e.g. 'otherwise unafflicted ... not desirable') -> a neutral-positive baseline, moderate (2). Distinct from the stronger 'not afflicted' -> fairly good.
notes.bare roots: bare 'strong'/'powerful'/'good' WITHOUT an intensifier are intentionally NOT mapped (too ambiguous) -> unmappable/excluded.
